name: Agony
source:
In the world where human being and inhuman are in war.
Abnormal monsters join up in the battle and have an eye on half-humans to procreate.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE054689.html]DLsite English[/url]]

异常怪物加入战斗，并关注半人类的繁衍。
